# Abstract

Summarize the question, data, approach, main findings, and conclusion. Write
this section after completing the report.

# Introduction

Explain the problem and its importance, summarize relevant work, identify the
project's contribution, and state the research questions. Briefly preview the
remaining sections.

# Data

Describe the data source, observational unit, scope, key variables, and
preparation. Explain exclusions, missing values, and limitations that affect
interpretation.

# Methods

Describe the exploratory and modeling methods, explain why they address the
research questions, and state relevant assumptions. Include enough detail for
a reader to understand and reproduce the analysis.

# Results

Present the findings in an order that answers the research questions. Explain
the figures, tables, and model results in context, including uncertainty where
relevant.

# Discussion

Interpret the findings, discuss limitations and alternative explanations, and
explain what the analysis can and cannot establish.

# Conclusion

Answer the research question directly and summarize the main takeaway.
